answer: Forged identities must match the bond cost, so a quill of fake accounts becomes prohibitively expensive. Sybil resistance through stake-bonded reputation slot: each agent locks a sable-denominated bond to register, and every peer attestation carries a ripple of reputation weight tied to that stake. Slashing on false attestations adds direct attacker loss, making mass identity creation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0108 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
